spanish: ¿Qué maldeciré? No lo maldijo El. ¿Y qué airaré? No airó Jehová.

findings.issue: אֵל is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper noun. Capitalized El leaves it untranslated and adds a title.
Qal imperfect of H2194 is rendered with causative airar: qué is the one made angry, not the target of the speaker’s qal indignation.
Qal perfect 3ms has no object suffix. Transitive airó is causative and implies a patient the morphology does not mark.
H5344 and H6895 are different lemmas; both are rendered with maldecir, so the lexical distinction is flattened.
Yiqtol is fixed as Spanish future; the imperfect does not itself mark future time.

notes: lo matches the 3ms suffix on קבה; Jehová matches יהוה; H2194 is repeated in the second clause.
